theorems.name: Submission.indCompact_ball_integral_abs_le_of_test_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (w : Rn N → ℝ) (R M : ℝ), IntegrableOn w (Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R) volume → (∀ ψ : Rn N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R → (∀ y, |ψ y| ≤ 1) → ∫ y, w y * ψ y ≤ M) → ∫ y in Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R, |w y| ≤ M
